probes.summary: All seven legs ran and passed; nothing inconclusive. Leg A (one session, four questions): the p5 plugin's hooks, workflows and bin/ all loaded under --setting-sources project,local --strict-mcp-config with the sandbox-off --settings flag honoured (proven by a commit inside .git/worktrees/x); the typed workflow command /p5:one <dir> started the named workflow with no skill (num_turns 1, no denials, run record script byte-equal to the plugin's one.js, status completed); bare tool names admitted a Read outside the project, Write/Edit and a commit in .worktrees/x on story/x (commit e2b67c6, both marker files); and every step payload carried the agent file's effort (low) under a session at medium, settling item 26 and earning STEP_EFFORT_PROVEN=True. Leg B (0.05-dollar cap): the session exits 1 with subtype error_max_budget_usd, is_error true, empty result text, while the run record reads completed with the whole workflow result and no step left running - a shape the plans did not assume; filed as PR5-1 (minor). Leg C: session records live at ~/.claude/projects/<project path with every character outside A-Za-z0-9_- replaced by ->/<session id>/, shape identical between the kept round-4 folder and leg A, and for by-name calls script and the file at scriptPath equal the plugin file byte for byte in both rounds. Leg D: rerun A of the round-4 check re-held items 36, 37, 38 and 40 on 2.1.332 (agent_type/agent_id, rewrite into open and declared schemas, closed-schema failure after 5 logged attempts, allow+rewrite admitted with the silent-hook control refused in the same session, exit-2 block heard whole with the ZEBRA-31 token). Recorded: rewrite/spike/probes-round-5/ (per-leg folders with hook logs split to stay under 16 KB, result JSONs, run records, journals, the exact plugin copies, run scripts, COMMANDS.md, RESULTS.md); new platform items 50-55 in rewrite/spec/topics/platform-proven-3.md, registered in registry.d/probes.toml and indexed from platform.md, which also gained the round-5 pointers, a proven row 26 (open section removed), updated Headless-runs bullets, and PR5-1 in the findings paragraph, landing at 16381 bytes (under the 16384 limit); findings.py build re-run with PR5-1. spec_lint.py reports 0 problems; sections.py coverage reports 0 uncovered sections. next/, plugins/, crates/, rewrite/history/, rewrite/tools/, rewrite/plans/ untouched; no git state-changing commands run in the repository. Total probe cost about 0.35 USD.

check.verdict: The gate passed in the primary form. Legs A1, A2 and A3 pass as ORDER-6 8.2 specifies: no repeat without the isolation flags was needed, and no repeat with Skill. The prober's session and my own rerun of leg A with the exact flags agree; my rerun was in /Users/jmagady/.vsdd-probes/round-5-check.Y3aUf7 with the calling session's CLAUDE_* variables cleared. I checked 7 results and the evidence supports 6 (A1, A2, A3, A4, C, D). Leg B is not supported as recorded: the stop never fell inside a workflow, because the 5-cent cap was crossed only by the main loop's answer after the workflow had ended, and the result file has no 'result' key at all, where the prober recorded an empty string. My rerun at a 2-cent cap answers B's real question: the platform stops background agents, the run record ends 'killed' with an 'error' key and result null, and the step that was running is left in 'progress' with its result lost. Errors in the record: main-session Workflow payloads do carry effort (the session's medium); 'the agent file's effort' was never tested; and a refused step call is not listed in the session's permission_denials. On that last point, leg D's R3CTRL and round 4's rerun A both show the refusal while permission_denials stays empty. My rerun with the agent file at xhigh, agent() at low and the session at medium gives low on every step payload: the effort the step was dispatched with wins. So STEP_EFFORT_PROVEN = True is earned. For the first run: the isolation default and the allowed-tools list stay as planned, and Skill stays out. These change: STEP_EFFORT_PROVEN becomes true; the budget_stop diagnosis must cover both shapes; denial detection must read the step transcripts; and the spec wording of items 37 and 52 to 55 needs the fixes listed. The report is in /Users/jmagady/dev2/vsdd-factory/rewrite/spike/probes-round-5/CHECK.md.

A3 still passes on the PostToolUse lines (Read outside cwd, Write, Edit, compound git commit) and git (e2b67c6 on story/x). Item 52 should drop that citation and record the fact.
Item 52 says the first run's tool list 'covers the story step's write scope'. That goes past one Read, one Write, one Edit and one commit.

RESULTS.md, item 53 and extra-probes-5.json say main-session Workflow events carry no effort key. Hook log lines 2-3 carry effort {level: medium}, the session's; the same holds in my rerun and in leg D.

'The agent file's value' was never tested: worker.md and the agent() call both said low. My rerun (agent file xhigh, agent() low, session medium) gives low on all 14 step payloads, so the payload carries the dispatched effort, which wins over the agent file. Item 53 and platform.md row 26 have this wrong.

The leg tested an easier case than its question. At the 0.05 cap the spend crossed the cap only with the main loop's second answer, written at 06:29:07.128 after the workflow notification at 06:29:07.034, so no step was running. PR5-1's 'instead of assuming a killed workflow' generalises from that one case. My 0.02-cap run shows a mid-workflow stop kills the workflow: stderr 'Budget limit reached ($0.05 of $0.02); stopping background agents.', record status killed, error 'Workflow aborted', result null, T1 left in progress with its StructuredOutput seen by the hook but never recorded, and a spend of $0.054 on a $0.02 cap.
'result: ""' (empty text) is wrong: B-result.json has no result key at all. It has errors ['Reached maximum budget ($0.05)'] and terminal_reason budget_exhausted. Item 54 and PR5-1 repeat the error.

The naming rule claims '_' survives. Only '/' and '.' were shown: no probed path, and no folder under ~/.claude/projects, has an underscore. LEG-C also says the journal has one 'launched' line per agent, when it has one per run, then a started and a result line per agent. It does not mention that step transcripts repeat some tool_use entries in api-request-blob records, or that a killed record adds an error key with result null.

Item 37's closed-schema failure changed on 2.1.332. Round 4 saw four refusals, a 'subagent completed without calling StructuredOutput (after in-conversation nudge)' error and about 190 s; this round saw five attempts in about 10 s and the error 'StructuredOutput retry cap (5) exceeded'. platform-proven-3's header calls this 're-held, including the closed-schema failure', and item 37's text is not updated.

Three deviations from round 4's rerun A go unrecorded in platform-proven-3.md. Leg D entered by the typed command, not the probecall skill. It ran under the isolation flags, the sandbox flag and the ceiling variable. And R3B's rewrite was not rebuilt, so item 38's StructuredOutput leg rests on R2A/R2B.
PR5-1 contradicts itself: the problem says STEP_EFFORT_PROVEN 'can ship true', while the proposed resolution says 'no change is needed for ... STEP_EFFORT_PROVEN'. It ships false, so it must change.
